introduction: A program is a sequence of precise instructions. Plan a route to the beeper, then translate it into commands.
explanation: move(); advances Karel by exactly one square in its current direction. Each command ends with a semicolon. A beeper is shown as a gold coin; in this task it marks the destination.
objective: Reach the beeper at (4, 1) in three forward steps. Finish facing east and leave the beeper on the ground.
instruction: Write the commands inside main. Read the coordinates as (avenue, street). Compile and step through your program, then check the complete solution.
hints: Karel already faces east. Count the gaps between the starting square and the beeper.
One move(); crosses one gap. Repeat the command on separate lines inside main.
The route is three squares long. Use three move(); commands, each followed by a semicolon.

illustration.alt: Before: Karel is on square 1, facing right. After move(); Karel is on square 2, still facing right. Each strip contains three squares.
illustration.caption: One command. One square. The same direction.

title: Reach the beeper
